title: queer-tv-guide snapshot v1
description: The offline dataset the iOS app renders. Built nightly by pipeline/ from LezWatch.TV (shows, characters, deaths, ratings, tropes, where-to-watch links) and TVmaze (episode schedule). Absence is always explicit: a field the source did not record is null (or an empty list) and, where it matters, is paired with a *_known boolean. The app must never render null as "no".

schema_version.description: Major version of this contract. The app rejects any other value.

generated_at.description: UTC time the snapshot was built. The only top-level field excluded from content_digest.

content_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this document with generated_at and build.run removed. Two builds over the same mirror produce the same digest; the app may use it to skip re-parsing.

snapshot.description: The license this snapshot file is published under. ShareAlike attaches to the file (a database that incorporates TVmaze data, CC BY-SA 4.0 s.4(b)); it does not attach to the app code that reads it.

notice.description: Plain-language license notice the app must show on its attribution screen, verbatim.

attribution.description: One entry per source. The app must display every entry's text and link on an attribution screen reachable from the main navigation, and must link each show and character to its source_url.

wikidata.description: The last good read of Wikidata through QLever, which may be up to a week old or older: its counts describe that read, not this run. Added after the first v1 files; absent means none was available.

with_join_key.description: Shows carrying a LezWatch tvmaze id, a manual tvmaze id, or an IMDb id.

joined.description: Shows for which TVmaze returned a show record.

not_found.description: TVmaze answered 404 for every key we had.

shared_tvmaze_id.description: Shows whose key resolved to a TVmaze show that another LezWatch show also resolved to. The join cannot say which one TVmaze means, so each has schedule_known: false. Listed in shared_tvmaze_ids. Added after the first v1 files; absent means not counted.

shared_tvmaze_ids.description: One entry per TVmaze show that more than one LezWatch show resolved to, by tvmaze_id ascending, for a person to review. Added after the first v1 files; absent means not checked.

wikidata.description: What the build took from the last good Wikidata read and what it left out, by reason (DECISIONS 0055). Added after the first v1 files; absent means none was available.

fields.description: Keyed by dotted field path, e.g. "shows.watch_links", "characters.death". Two numbers for every field whose absence the app might otherwise read as a value.

placements.description: How many death events (character x date x show, DECISIONS 0030 and 0041) were placed at each precision. Added after the first v1 files; absent means placements were not computed.

episode_lists.description: Joined shows with a recorded death (wanted) and how many of them have a TVmaze episode list in this build (cached).

shifted_control.description: The placebo control: the share of death dates placed at the episode level as recorded and when moved shift_days later. The build refuses when an enforced control's shifted rate reaches max_shifted_rate. Rates are null when no date could be tried.

taxonomies.description: Every term LezWatch defines, for browse/filter screens. Records embed {slug, name} copies of the terms they carry, so the app does not need to join.

placement.description: One recorded death date matched by air date to one show's TVmaze episode list (DECISIONS 0041). A date says only that the character died at some point; a later return is not recorded, so never read a placement as "still dead".

show_id.description: null only when the date counts for none of the character's shows (reason no_show_in_death_year or date_not_recorded).

precision.description: episode: one episode (episodes has one number). episode_pair: two episodes aired the same day, say "episode 7 or 8". special: a TVmaze special, named by airdate, not by a number. season: the season only (season set, episodes null). unplaced: neither (season and episodes null). other_show: a crossover date that lands on an episode of another of the character's shows, so it is not counted here.

reason.description: Which matching rule decided the precision (pipeline/src/qtv_pipeline/episodes.py).

airdate.description: Set only for precision special: the day the special aired.

datetime.description: UTC, second precision, RFC 3339 with a literal Z.

show_id.description: Stable id: LezWatch's WordPress post id. Post ids never change; slugs and titles can.

count.description: LezWatch's own usage count for the term, null if it did not report one.

available.description: What the source said it has (X-WP-Total). null if the source did not say.

fetched_at.description: When the most recent fetch from this source finished. Excluded from content_digest.

requests.description: HTTP requests made to this source in the run that produced this snapshot. Excluded from content_digest.

bytes.description: Response bytes received in that run. Excluded from content_digest.

end.description: null when the source gave no finish year, whether the show is ongoing or the field is simply blank; read on_air for the distinction.

on_air.description: LezWatch's lezshows_on_air flag as recorded; "unknown" when the field is absent.

worth_it.description: LezWatch's verdict as recorded (observed values: "Yes", "Meh", "No", "TBD"). null when not rated.

worth_it_details.description: LezWatch's worth-it explanation, HTML stripped to plain text.

quality.description: null when unrated (LezWatch stores 0 for unrated; the pipeline maps 0 to null).

score.description: LezWatch's computed show score (lezshows_the_score). Its formula changed 2026-08-31; treat as an ordinal, not a percentage.

airtime.description: Local broadcast time as TVmaze records it, "HH:MM" or empty.

airstamp.description: RFC 3339 with offset, as TVmaze records it.

url.description: TVmaze episode page; satisfies TVmaze attribution when linked.

schedule_known.description: true iff TVmaze returned a show record for this show and no other LezWatch show resolved to the same TVmaze show (coverage.tvmaze.shared_tvmaze_ids). When false every other field here is null and the app must say "schedule unknown", not "no upcoming episode".

method.description: Which key produced the match (or was tried last).

status.description: TVmaze status verbatim (observed: "Running", "Ended", "To Be Determined", "In Development").

next_episode.description: null with schedule_known=true means TVmaze lists no upcoming episode (a positive statement). null with schedule_known=false means unknown.

alternate_names.description: Other titles a show is known by, for search only. Empty when none is known. show.wikidata.alternate_names says where each Wikidata one came from.

wikidata.description: Provenance for values taken from Wikidata. Present only when this show has one. Added after the first v1 files; a reader may ignore it.

matched_by.description: The ids that all named this item. Always lezwatch and at least one other.

seasons.description: Set when show.seasons came from Wikidata.

source_url.description: The LezWatch.TV page. Link it: LezWatch asks for a link back.

summary.description: LezWatch's excerpt, HTML stripped to plain text (entities decoded).

seasons.description: Season count as LezWatch records it. null when not recorded: LezWatch stores 0 for a count never filled in, and the pipeline maps 0 to null, never "0 seasons". When LezWatch has none, Wikidata's count, if its ids agree and TVmaze has no count or the same one; show.wikidata.seasons then says so.

format.description: LezWatch lez_formats term, e.g. "TV Show", "Web Series".

networks.description: LezWatch stations. Empty when none recorded.

triggers.description: LezWatch trigger warnings. Empty means none recorded, not none present.

characters.description: Computed by the pipeline from the characters array.

deaths.description: Computed: characters on this show with died=true.

tvmaze.description: As recorded by LezWatch (manual override wins). The joined id lives in schedule.tvmaze_id.

host.description: Registrable host of the url, for a label (e.g. "netflix.com"). Never a guessed service name.

watch_links.description: Where-to-watch links exactly as LezWatch records them, to open in Safari. Empty when LezWatch has none; the pipeline never guesses one.

similar_show_ids.description: Only ids that exist in this snapshot.

plot.description: LezWatch's plot/spoiler notes, HTML stripped to plain text with line breaks. May contain spoilers; the app should hide it behind a tap.

queer_episodes.description: LezWatch's notable-episodes list, HTML stripped to plain text with line breaks.

episode_counts.description: TVmaze's numbered regular episodes per season, seasons ascending, aired or announced; specials are not counted (DECISIONS 0041). null when this build has no TVmaze episode list for the show: only joined shows with a recorded death are fetched. Never read null as zero episodes. Added after the first v1 files; absent means not computed.

died.description: true when LezWatch records a death. null otherwise. NEVER false: LezWatch does not record survival, only deaths, so absence is "no recorded death", not "survives".

death_known.description: true iff died is true. The app renders death_known=false as "no recorded death".

placements.description: Where this death falls, one entry per show it counts for under DECISIONS 0030, by show id (DECISIONS 0041). Added after the first v1 files; absent means not computed.

dates.description: One entry per recorded death (a character can die more than once). Empty when death_known=false.

counted.description: Present only when died is true (DECISIONS 0053). true when LezWatch.TV also lists the character as dead (the `dead` cliche, shown on its character pages as "Status: Dead"). false when it records a death date but lists the character as alive (a death the show undid, a resurrection). `died` still means a death date is recorded, and `dates` stay for episode placement (0041). Absent means not computed (files from before 0053): a reader keeps the old reading. false is rendered as a death date recorded for a character listed as alive: never as alive, never as dead.

gender.description: As LezWatch records it. null when unrecorded.

romantic.description: Romantic orientation, recorded for a minority of characters.

cliches.description: LezWatch clichés/tropes on the character (includes "Dead" for dead characters; death.died is the authority).

name.description: null when the actor id did not resolve in the actor export.

years.description: Years the character appears, as LezWatch records them.

shows.description: Only shows that exist in this snapshot.
